messages:
sarah (AE): Urgent escalation  NovaHealth POC blocked by CISO: no PHI outside EEA; wants customer-managed infra or written EEA-only commitment. Procurement also contesting POC pricing. Need exec note.

james (SE): Tech summary: their test hit rate-limit failures. Hosted EU exists but policy insists on customer VPC or on-prem for PHI.

maya (sales_engineering): Recommend Redwood Private in their VPC for deterministic throughput. Provisioning ~48-72h.

oliver (eng-privacy): I can join a security call. We should offer customer KMS + audit clause. Need the exact CISO wording.

sarah (AE): CISO quote: "Vendor must not process PHI on third-party infrastructure; processing must remain under customer-controlled EEA boundaries."

alex (vp-sales): Plan: I will send an exec note committing to EEA-only POC in customer VPC and propose a call. Nora, fast-track a narrow amendment. Maya/James, 1-pager for cost/provisioning.

nora (legal): I'll draft an amendment (residency, subprocessors, audit, KMS). DM me CISO contact and exact ask.

maya (sales_engineering): Cost note: private POC ~+45% ops; offer 30% introductory discount for 3 months to bridge.

james (SE): Provisioning checklist: SAML exchange, VPC peering, firewall rules, KMS access, log forwarding. I'll pre-stage images to save time.

cal-bot: Meeting created  "NovaHealth POC - Security sync" Mon 09:00 CET. Invites sent.

sarah (AE): Customer replied: "We need exec sign-off and amendment to start next week." This is gating.

alex (vp-sales): Nora + Oliver prioritize amendment + attestation. I'll send exec note and include Head of Security. Post copy here first.

oliver (eng-privacy): I'll prepare a short attestation covering encryption-at-rest, no egress of model artifacts outside EEA, and audit rights.

nora (legal): Amendment ready to attach pending Alex's wording. Will request expedited review with their counsel.

sarah (AE): Thanks all. Please post final email here before sending. :thumbsup:
